meta.name: mcp-builder
meta.description: Guide for creating high-quality MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that enable LLMs to interact with external services through well-designed tools. Use when building MCP servers to integrate external APIs or services, whether in Python (FastMCP) or Node/TypeScript (MCP SDK).

copy.tagline: 构建高质量 MCP 服务器，让 LLM 调用外部服务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在开发 MCP 服务器来连接外部 API 或服务
copy.tagline_en: Build high-quality MCP servers to let LLMs call external services
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building MCP servers to connect external APIs or services

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按照一套流程指导你创建 MCP 服务器，包括研究规划、编码实现、代码审查和创建测试题。它会帮你设计工具、写代码、检查质量，并生成评估用例。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 构建一个 MCP 服务器（例如“帮我写一个 MCP 服务器”），或者需要集成外部 API 时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个 MCP 服务器，用来查询天气。
say.note: Claude 会启动研究规划流程，指导你完成服务器开发。

say.text: 为我的 MCP 服务器生成 10 个评估问题。
say.note: Claude 会加载评估指南并创建测试用例。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you through a process to create MCP servers: research and planning, implementation, review and refinement, and creating evaluations. It helps design tools, write code, check quality, and generate test questions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to build an MCP server (e.g., 'help me create an MCP server') or need to integrate an external API.

say_en.text: Create an MCP server for querying weather.
say_en.note: Claude will start the research and planning phase.

say_en.text: Generate 10 evaluation questions for my MCP server.
say_en.note: Claude will load the evaluation guide and create test cases.
